about.title: About this demo
about.intro: This application is a technical demonstration of a modern enterprise SPA built with React 18, Vite 5 and Tailwind CSS 3.
about.purpose: Its goal is to show how to structure a medium-scale web application: reusable components, global state with Zustand, internationalisation with i18next, routing with React Router DOM and coherent styles with Tailwind.
